basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old software engineer based in London, with a keen interest in MMORPGs like RuneScape and exploring niche financial systems like those in Starling Bank. When I'm not coding or gaming, I enjoy sailing and often spend weekends navigating the Thames. I have a cat named Whiskers and am in a long-term relationship with my partner who shares my love for adventure sports. Typically online during evenings after work, around 6-11 PM GMT.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working as a software engineer for over 5 years. My interest in gaming has been lifelong, supplemented by self-taught expertise in financial systems through active participation in forums and personal research.
